newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine ten-month exports up at $16.809 billion.
newsitem.headline: Philippine ten-month exports up at $16.809 billion.

text.p: The Philippine's merchandise exports in the first ten months of the year grew by 16.7 percent to $16.809 billion from the year-earlier $14.404 billion, the National Statistic Office (NSO) reported on Wednesday.
Note - Figures are in billion U.S. dollars.

The NSO said exports in October were led by electronics and components which increased by 30.7 percent to $770.5 million from the year-earlier $589.3 million. Electronic exports accounted for 40.9 percent of overseas sales.

Garments, which was the second biggest earner with a share of 10.1 percent of the total, recorded sales of $187.9 million, 11.8 percent lower than last year's $213.0 million. Government officials earlier said garment exports were outpriced by more competitive countries.
